map.→ 打开颜色名称查询工具: -> Open the colour name lookup tool
map.为什么同一个 Hex 有多个名字？: Why does one HEX have several names?
map.同色可有多个近似名，取最接近。: The same colour may have several approximate names; take the closest.
map.由 HEX 查近似颜色名。: Look up an approximate colour name from a HEX.
map.界面选色时由 Hex 反查色名，方便与设计或开发沟通「这是什么颜色」。: In the UI, look up the colour name from a Hex to make it easy to ask designers or developers "what colour is this?".
map.色名库来自不同标准（如 CSS 命名色与中文习惯色名），同一色值可能对应多个名称: The colour name library draws on different standards (such as CSS named colours and conventional Chinese colour names), so one value may map to several names; the page gives the closest one.
map.输入色值查询颜色名称，或输入颜色名查询对应的色值，包含中文传统颜色大全: Enter a colour value to look up the colour name, or a colour name to look up its value, including the full set of traditional Chinese colour names
